Decimal.description: Exact decimal string; unit-aware checks and precision limits are enforced by the domain.

StoryPoint.description: tick uses work calendar; phase is accepted causal stage, never database sequence or model completion order.

StoryInterval.description: Domain enforces start < end. Instant events use StoryPoint, not an empty interval.

WorldRef.description: All three identifiers are checked together against an immutable branch/revision membership; main is resolved before issue.

TextSpan.description: Offsets address the exact UTF-8 decoded artifact without normalization. Domain enforces end > start and verifies quoted content.

DependencyManifest.description: Server-internal complete manifest. Do not expose unauthorized scope names or predicates to restricted roles. Fingerprint uses canonical JSON of this object.

ContextBundle.description: Server-issued and persisted; caller cannot grant itself role/actor/branch/time by editing this JSON. Public facts are already filtered.

QueryAnswer.description: truth_status is determinacy, not boolean truth. UNKNOWN is indistinguishable for hidden and absent records at the role view boundary. COMPLETE is relative to declared scope, model, time and permissions.

ActionProposal.description: Action actor_id is verified against task grant; intent does not assert success. Resource requests are not yet consumption.

oneOf.description: Recording that a statement was heard does not record belief in its contents. Belief and private decision require separate accepted records and evidence.

AdjudicationProposal.description: reasoning_summary is an auditable explanation, not hidden chain of thought. Hard constraints and scope checks happen before acceptance.

AcceptedEvent.description: Immutable selected event version. Replay applies this result, never regenerates model output. Causal ordering and effect coverage require semantic validation.

Approval.description: World acceptance requires ACCEPTED plus satisfied policy. Approval is a stored server record, not authority granted by submitting this JSON.

CommitReceipt.description: A duplicate command returns its original receipt. branch_seq orders only this branch and is not story time.

SceneContract.description: Commitments describe already accepted facts at relevant points or explicitly declared pending work. Scene selection never applies world effects.

TaskSpec.description: Wall deadline controls execution only. It cannot make a character late in the story. READY/BLOCKED or RUNNING preparation may have no bundle yet; before any external call the service must bind a persisted bundle/fingerprint to the current generation. Result receipt verifies task/generation/attempt/context together.

TaskResult.description: Successful result receipt does not mean world acceptance or literary approval.

ReviewIssue.description: An issue must provide evidence; a literary preference cannot masquerade as a universal hard invariant.

ReleaseManifest.description: Local release. Domain verifies exact ordered content, disclosures, current authority, approved dependencies and world lineage. External delivery has separate status and receipt.

ProcessRecord.description: world_stage is fiction state; evaluation_status describes whether computation resolved the requested scope. evaluated_frontier is exclusive. Waiting for a model never suspends the caravan in the fiction.

NonnegativeDecimal.description: Nonnegative exact decimal; domain enforces unit and finite precision.

ProcessAdvance.description: Scheduler-owned progress metadata, committed with a WorldChangeSet, not a world occurrence or resource effect. Coverage is strictly before evaluated_frontier; events at the frontier remain unresolved unless the frontier advances to a later causal phase.

WorldChangeSet.description: Prepared by trusted application services. AcceptedEvent describes event payload shape only; existence in this proposal does not mean acceptance. Commit membership grants accepted status. Process advances are recomputed/verified by the scheduler, not accepted on model assertion.

OccurrenceTime.description: Time of an occurrence, not a duration. BOUNDED endpoints are inclusive possible points; domain checks earliest <= latest and causal constraints. Do not sort an uncertain occurrence by an invented exact point.

RecordSelectionProposal.description: Typed immutable payload is domain-validated; replacing/deactivating checks the prior selected version. This field does not permit arbitrary table writes.

TriggerEvaluation.description: Trigger closure is committed atomically with its resulting events and process advances; replay does not fire it again.

EventSelectionOperation.description: Each selected version must exist as a validated immutable payload. Prior version must match target selection. ADD never reapplies an inherited occurrence. REPLACE/DEACTIVATE affecting accepted history require repair policy; ordinary accepts cannot bypass it.

PrepareRetconRequest.description: Prepares an isolated repair. Null earliest impact means start from genesis or prove a conservative bound; it does not mean no impact. The referenced WorldChangeSet explicitly selects event replacements/deactivations.

PromotionRequest.description: Privileged control-plane command. CAS both expected canon pointer/head and candidate head; verify approved manifest, projections and closure. This command is not exposed to ordinary runtime roles.
